replacement_reason: Requested after inspecting the original corrected validation results: Linear SVM caught 0/21 positives and Extra trees caught 1/21. Logistic regression is retained as a transparent baseline. This is a post-hoc model-roster revision, not prespecified validation.

neural.classifier_weighting: balanced sample weights computed from training labels only
neural.autoencoder_training: network reconstruction targets use known-benign training windows only; preprocessing uses all known training windows
neural.preprocessing: training-only median imputation, log1p and StandardScaler
neural.selection: One fixed configuration per neural model; no tuning or retries after observing new validation scores. Loss-based stopping uses training data only.

implementation_rerun: The first implementation attempt stopped at a serialized-score check that restored the default BLAS thread count before comparing with one-thread scores. Verification now explicitly uses the registered one-thread setting. Architectures, hyperparameters, seed, populations, thresholds and timing protocol are unchanged; no model choice was changed based on new validation performance.
neural_deferral_revision: The original protocol deferred MLP pending independent episode support. This separately registered user-requested revision permits small neural models on the existing data without claiming that independence improved or that the original deferral was satisfied.
limitations: Same historical capture and previously inspected validation windows; no new independent holdout
Correlated windows and recurring sources; no independent-episode confidence intervals
Only 24 positive training windows; neural fit stability and generalization are limited
No Friday access, live-provider calls, production detection claim or application-bundle repointing
SQL control scores are reused from the verified parent; SQL scoring latency is not represented as model inference latency
